messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Bengali, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Bengali line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | A | preposition “to” (introduces the addressees) | কাছে | “to/near” | OK | | le | definite article, plural “the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | quai | relative pronoun “whom / those” | যে | “who/that” | OK | | poi | adverb “thereafter / later” | পরে | “later” | OK | | se | conditional conjunction “if” | যদি | “if” | OK | | tu | 2nd‑person singular pronoun “thou” | তুমি | “you” | OK | | vorrai | future volitional “will want / wilt” | চাও | “want” (future sense understood) | OK | | salire | infinitive “to ascend” | আরোহন করতে | “to ascend” | OK | | anima | noun “soul” | আত্মা | “soul” | OK | | fia | future of “to be” – “shall be” | হবে | “will be” | OK | | a | preposition “for” (introducing the domain) | যে | “for/which” | OK | | ciò | demonstrative “that” (the ascent) | সেই | “that” | OK | | più | comparative adverb “more” | অধিক | “more” | OK | | di | preposition of comparison “than” | চেয়ে | “than” | OK | | me | 1st‑person pronoun “I” (standard of comparison) | আমার | “my” | OK | | degna | adjective “worthy” | যোগ্য | “worthy” | OK | | con | preposition “with” | সঙ্গে | “with” | OK | | lei | pronoun “her” (the female companion) | তার | “her” | OK | | ti | pronoun “thee / you (acc.)” | তোমাকে | “you (object)” | OK | | lascerò | future “will leave” | ছেড়ে দেব | “will leave” | OK | | nel | preposition “at the” (locating the action) | প্রস্থানকালে | “at the time of departure” | OK | | mio | possessive adjective “my” | আমার | “my” | OK | | partire | infinitive nominalized “departure” | প্রস্থান | “departure” | OK |
---
### Items to Note - **UNNECESSARY**: *le* – Italian definite article has no direct counterpart in Bengali and is naturally omitted. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were identified.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Bengali script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Bengali text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 121** - Original: যে সকলের কাছে তুমি পরে যদি আরোহন করতে চাও, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 122** - Original: তখন একটি আত্মা হবে যা সেই বিষয়ে আমার চেয়ে অধিক যোগ্য হবে: - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 123** - Original: তার সঙ্গে আমি তোমাকে আমার প্রস্থানকালে ছেড়ে দেব; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` যে সকলের কাছে তুমি পরে যদি আরোহন করতে চাও, তখন একটি আত্মা হবে যা সেই বিষয়ে আমার চেয়ে অধিক যোগ্য হবে: তার সঙ্গে আমি তোমাকে আমার প্রস্থানকালে ছেড়ে দেব; ```
